title: Relay JSON responses
responsibility: Builds standard JSON replies and concise coded failures.

inputs.name: relayResponse.headers
inputs.description: Optional additional headers, defaulting to empty; supplied keys override the default headers.

inputs.name: relayError.error
inputs.description: Typed relay error code, serialized as the only body field.

inputs.name: relayError.headers
inputs.description: Optional additional failure-response headers, defaulting to empty.

outputs.name: relayResponse
outputs.description: Response containing JSON with default application/json, no-store and nosniff headers.

outputs.name: relayError
outputs.description: Response containing only the error code object, using the same response/header construction.
